canonical_project: Thomas-Krenn Freyung show data center / in-house data center expansion
notes: Thomas-Krenn's official 2012 expansion announcement says its Freyung building expansion put special emphasis on an in-house data center and additional showroom; the 'Show-Rechenzentrum' lets customers test products live on site or remotely. DataCenter-Insider reported Thomas-Krenn officially opened a further Freyung production-site expansion in 2026. MW capacity not disclosed.
